checks.name: a14-determinism-and-quota
checks.summary: A14 MEASURED. QUOTA: the two commands' actual read and write counts are measured with a counting Transactor and UnitOfWork wrapper following the countingUnit idiom human_input_test.go already keeps in this package, counting one write for each aggregate/canonical-target save and three for Record (the event document plus the idempotency record plus the quota document the adapter writes for every mutation, counted conservatively in the same direction the reservation is). Verbatim: 'A14 the plan: reads=4 writes=6; reservation reads=32 writes=16' and 'A14 the prepare: reads=4 writes=4; reservation reads=32 writes=16'. Both fit well inside quota.MutationUsage (Reads 32 / Writes 16 at internal/quota/quota.go:62), so no budget was raised, internal/quota was not touched and no escalation was required. Plan's four reads are the idempotency record, the Requirement, the Repository link (RE-ORDERED, not added -- it already performed this read, later in the callback) and the Control Intent collection; Prepare's four are the idempotency record, the Increment, the Repository link (NEW) and the Control Intent collection, so each command adds at most two reads and zero writes. DETERMINISM: no new or modified test starts a goroutine, takes a sleep, arms a timer, reads the wall clock or uses randomness -- every Service is built with the package's injected clock{} (a fixed time.Unix(1700000000, 0).UTC()) and there is no waiting of any kind to express, so no deadline poll was needed; no measured duration is asserted anywhere, and the only durations that appear are t.Logf observations. The whole suite was run with -race and reported no data race. READ-TRANSACTION HAZARD AVOIDED, not weakened: the new tests read canonical state through the memory store's own inspectors and through a plain st.Transact, never through Service's read boundary, so the four-read-transactions-per-budget-day ceiling that the in-memory adapter's missing quota.Counter.TrueUp imposes is never approached; no assertion was weakened, no read was dropped and no clock had to be advanced. That adapter defect is V2-087's and is recorded, not fixed.
